### How to drill the matrix

The matrix ships as a forced-choice drill. Each item presents a real LSAT stimulus and two flaw labels from the same row. The student picks which one fits and explains why. This is the single highest-leverage drill for moving from 80% accuracy on Flaw to 95%+. Source for stimuli: Fallacy Homework.md and _scan_Fallacy_Homework.pdf, both already in the homework set.
